message.content:
The theory of relativity was formulated by **Albert Einstein**.  
- **Special Relativity** was published in 1905 (the paper “Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper” in *Annalen der Physik*).  
- **General Relativity** followed in 1915 (the paper “Die Feldgleichungen der Gravitation” in *Sitzungsberichte der Preussischen Akademie der Wissenschaften*).
